snapshotOrigin: Persisted October 28 EPL chronological experiment; previously inspected history, not an independent test.
brierFormula: mean(sum((p[k]-1{actual=k})**2 for k in 0..2)); no division by 3; range 0..2
historicalAccuracyPolicy: argmax, first outcome wins exact ties (matches original saved report)
supplementaryAccuracyPolicy: unique maximum with 1e-12 tolerance; tied tops have no single pick and remain in proper-score metrics

matchSource.use: Only E0 dates, seasons, clubs and goals; statistics columns ignored. Outcomes, v1 and base independently reconstructed.

liveSnapshot.note: Read-only public API snapshot supplied by parent. Recomputed separately, never pooled with historical seasons.
